svg.text: CVA6 Misaligned Jump Instruction & MTVAL Capture Waveform (Cycles 467 – 479)
Execution of JR t6 (target 0x8000_0402 with bit 1 set and RVC=0) triggers INSTR_ADDR_MISALIGNED (Cause 0) at Cyc 470, latching fault target into MTVAL and jumping to MTVEC.

• Cyc 470: JR t6 attempts target 0x8000_0402. In branch_unit.sv, target_address[1] != 0 triggers exception with cause=0 and tval=0x8000_0402. • Cyc 471: Core vectors to MTVEC (0x8000_00a0); CSR unit captures mepc=0x8000_0080, mcause=0x0, and mtval=0x8000_0402 into hardware registers for diagnostics.
